subject_uz: Diaskintest (tuberkulyoz allergen, rekombinant) in'ektsiya eritmasi, 3 ml (30 doza) flakon

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot: Diaskintest, ichki terisiga yuborish uchun eritma 0,2 mkg/1 doza, 3 ml (30 doza) flakon.
requirements.summary_en: Product: Diaskintest, solution for intradermal injection 0.2 mcg/1 dose, 3 ml (30 doses) vial.
requirements.quote: Диаскинтест (аллерген туберкулёзный рекомбинантный для диагностики туберкулёза).

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlab chiqarish GMP bo'yicha sertifikatlangan maydonda amalga oshirilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Manufacture must take place at a GMP-certified site.
requirements.quote: Ишлаб чиқариш GMP талаблари бўйича сертификатланган майдонда амалга оширилиши лозим.

requirements.summary_uz: Saqlash va tashish +2 dan +8 daraja Selsiygacha, sovuq zanjir, termoindikator yoki logger majburiy.
requirements.summary_en: Storage and transport at +2 to +8 C under cold chain, with thermo-indicators or loggers mandatory.
requirements.quote: Наличие термоиндикаторов или логгеров температуры обязательно.

requirements.summary_uz: Birlamchi va ikkilamchi qadoqda «Sotish man etiladi» yozuvi, davlat va rus tillarida raqamli markirovka (Data Matrix).
requirements.summary_en: Primary and secondary packs must carry the sales-prohibited text and Data Matrix digital marking in state and Russian languages.
requirements.quote: На первичной и вторичной упаковке наносится надпись «Sotish man etiladi».

requirements.summary_uz: Qolgan yaroqlilik muddati: 3 yildan ortiq umumiy muddatda yetkazish kunida 50 foizdan ko'p qisqargan dori qabul qilinmaydi (2 yilgacha - 30, 3 yilgacha - 40 foiz).
requirements.summary_en: Remaining shelf life: product whose shelf life has shrunk by more than 30/40/50 percent at delivery (by total shelf life class) is not accepted.
requirements.quote: если срок их годности на день поставки сократился более чем на 30 процентов

requirements.summary_uz: Ulgurji yetkazib beruvchida amaldagi faoliyat litsenziyasi va GDP bo'yicha milliy sertifikat bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: A wholesale supplier needs a valid activity licence and the national GDP certificate.
requirements.quote: Наличие действующей лицензии на деятельность и национального сертификата надлежащей дистрибьюторской практики GDP

requirements.summary_uz: Xorijiy dori vositasi O'zbekiston Sog'liqni saqlash vazirligi huzuridagi Farmatsevtika mahsulotlari xavfsizligi markazida ro'yxatdan o'tgan bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: A foreign medicine must be registered with the Pharmaceutical Product Safety Centre under the Ministry of Health.
requirements.quote: ҳузуридаги «Фармацевтика маҳсулотлари хавфсизлиги маркази» давлат муассасасида рўйхатдан ўтказилган бўлиши керак

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlab chiqaruvchi zavod avtorizatsiyasi (ishtirokchi ishlab chiqaruvchi bo'lmasa) 5-shakl bo'yicha; yo'q bo'lsa ishtirokchi chetlatiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Manufacturer authorisation on form 5 is required if the bidder is not the producer; without it the bidder is excluded.
requirements.quote: Харид иштирокчиси таклиф этилаётган товар ишлаб чиқарувчиси бўлмаган тақдирда 5-шаклга мувофиқ расмийлаштирилади

requirements.summary_uz: Har bir seriya uchun ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki vakolatli organ bergan tahlil sertifikati, birlamchi sifat nazorati ma'lumotlari bilan.
requirements.summary_en: Each batch needs a certificate of analysis from the manufacturer or regulator with primary quality-control data.
requirements.quote: Поставщик обязан предоставить сертификат анализа на каждую поставляемую серию лекарственного средства

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi har bir seriya uchun sertifikatlash uchun qo'shimcha miqdor va standart namunalarni taqdim etishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The supplier must provide extra quantity of each batch and standard samples for certification and quality testing.
requirements.quote: поставщик обязан представить стандартные образцы действующего вещества, посторонних примесей и родственных веществ

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik topshiriqqa muvofiqlik (4 va 4a shakl) uchun 10 ball; yetkazish muddati qisqartirilsa 2 ballgacha; avtorizatsiya 1 ball. Texnik qism 60, narx 40 foiz, o'tish bali 11.
requirements.summary_en: Technical conformity (forms 4 and 4a) gives 10 points; shortened delivery up to 2; authorisation 1. Technical 60 percent, price 40, pass mark 11.

requirements.summary_uz: Tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar qog'ozda tasdiqlangan nusxa yoki vakolatli organning rasmiy elektron resursiga havola ko'rinishida taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Supporting documents are provided as certified paper copies or as links to the issuing authority's official electronic resource.
requirements.quote: Подтверждающие документы предоставляются в виде заверенных копий на бумажном носителе

flags.quote: Диаскинтест (аллерген туберкулёзный рекомбинантный для диагностики туберкулёза).
flags.explanation_uz: Xaridning predmeti savdo nomi (Diaskintest) bilan ko'rsatilgan, u xalqaro nopatent nomi sifatida berilgan va unga teng keluvchi (ekvivalent) mahsulot qabul qilinishi aytilmagan. Bu faqat bitta ishlab chiqaruvchi mahsulotini ko'rsatadi, boshlang'ich narx 16 499 945 541,6 so'm. Tibbiy sabab bo'lishi mumkin, shuning uchun mutaxassis tekshirishi kerak.
flags.explanation_en: The purchase is specified by trade name (Diaskintest), given in the place of an international non-proprietary name, and no equivalent product is said to be acceptable. This points to a single manufacturer's product; the start price is 16,499,945,541.6 UZS. A clinical reason may exist, so a specialist should check it.
flags.rewrite_uz: Rekombinant tuberkulyoz allergen (ESAT-6 va CFP-10 oqsillari), ichki terisiga yuborish uchun eritma 0,2 mkg/1 doza, BSJ vaksinasiga reaksiya bermaydigan, yoki unga teng ekvivalent dori vositasi.
flags.rewrite_en: Recombinant tuberculosis allergen (ESAT-6 and CFP-10 proteins), solution for intradermal use 0.2 mcg/1 dose, not reacting to BCG vaccination, or an equivalent medicine.

flags.quote: поставщик обязан представить стандартные образцы действующего вещества, посторонних примесей и родственных веществ
flags.explanation_uz: Har bir seriya uchun yetkazib beruvchidan faol modda, begona aralashmalar va turdosh moddalarning standart namunalari talab qilinmoqda. Rekombinant biologik preparat uchun bunday namunalarni faqat ishlab chiqaruvchi bera oladi, shuning uchun vositachi yetkazib beruvchilar qatnasha olmasligi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The supplier must provide standard samples of the active substance, impurities and related substances for every batch. For a recombinant biological product only the manufacturer can usually supply these, so intermediary suppliers may be unable to bid.
flags.rewrite_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi har bir seriya uchun ishlab chiqaruvchining tahlil sertifikatini va seriyaning qo'shimcha namunasini taqdim etadi; standart namunalar ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki vakolatli laboratoriya orqali olinishi mumkin.
flags.rewrite_en: The supplier provides the manufacturer's certificate of analysis and a retention sample of each batch; standard samples may be obtained through the manufacturer or an authorised laboratory.
